structured_output.summary: In src/ui/touch-controls.ts, createTouchControls now keeps an `entering` flag that enter(on) sets. zones() no longer caches while the flag is true: `entering ? measure() : (cache ??= measure())`. While the slots slide in, every hit test reads the slots' current position, so a touch in the first part of the countdown can't leave a mid-slide GAS/BRAKE zone cached. enter(false) at GO clears the flag and invalidates the cache as before, so caching starts again from the settled layout. Nothing else changes: no visuals, no physics, and the cache works as before outside the entry. Added tests/ui/touch-zones-entry-slide.test.ts, the verifier's test with the helpers import adjusted. It fails without the fix ('expected 520 to be 325') and passes with it. pnpm typecheck passes, and pnpm test passes 109 files, 734 tests.
